title: Examples need their conditions
lead: A design example and an internal comparison become informative when inputs, reference methods and misses are visible.
description: The supplied September 2026 overview does not authorize a public performance number or a claim of fabricated-chip validation.

sections.title: The sensing design example
paragraphs: A photonic glucose chip-design exercise can show how geometry and simulation are used. It cannot, on its own, show that glucose was measured.

sections.title: How to read a comparison
paragraphs: A credible benchmark records a dated version, reference solver, test cases, boundary conditions, successes, failures and the cost of each run. Without those details, a headline number would mislead.

sections.title: What evidence is next
paragraphs: Repeatable case studies and independently reviewable results would help distinguish useful engineering capabilities from promising experiments.
